message.content:
In a standard poker game the “most hearts” a single player can hold is limited by the number of cards in their hand.  
- **Texas Hold’em** (the default game type): each player can end up with 7 cards (2 hole cards + 5 community cards). The maximum hearts a player can have is **7**—i.e., a seven‑card flush of hearts.  
- **Seven‑Card Stud**: each player gets 7 cards, so again the maximum is 7 hearts.  
- **Five‑Card Draw**: each player gets 5 cards, so the maximum is 5 hearts.  

So, in Texas Hold’em the player who holds all 7 hearts (a seven‑card flush) has the highest possible number of hearts. In any other variant the maximum is simply the total number of cards dealt to a player.
